subject: general
question: In which year was the National Policy on Electronics and Software Products enacted, with the goal of propelling India's rise as a Software Product Nation and collaborating with the IT/ITES sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Policy on Electronics and Software Products was enacted in the year **2019**.
 
• This policy aims to propel India’s rise as a **Software Product Nation**.
 
• The policy focuses on **collaborating with the IT/ITES sector** to achieve its goals.
 
• It was designed to enhance the capabilities of India in **software products and services**.
 
• The policy targets the creation of a conducive environment for the **development and growth of the software product industry** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Policy on Electronics (NPE) 2019**

 
 
• The National Policy on Electronics 2019 aims to position India as a global hub for **Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM).**
 
• It includes initiatives to promote the manufacturing of core components and high-value products.
 
• The policy emphasizes research and development, skill development, and infrastructure development.
 
• It aims to attract investments and provide incentives for the electronics industry.
 
 
 
• **IT/ITES Sector in India**
 
 
• The IT/ITES sector has been a significant contributor to India’s GDP and employment.
 
• India is a leading destination for IT/ITES services, including software development, **BPO, and KPO.**
 
• The sector has seen substantial growth due to a skilled workforce and competitive costs.
 
• Government policies have aimed at fostering innovation and improving infrastructure for this sector.
 
 
 
• **Software Products**
 
 
• Software products refer to commercially marketed software solutions developed for various industries.
 
• They include enterprise software, system software, and application software.
 
• The development of software products involves stages like requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and maintenance.
 
• Innovation in software products can drive efficiency, security, and new capabilities for users.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Policy Frameworks**
 
 
• Policy frameworks provide a structured approach to achieving national goals in technology and industry.
 
• They help in creating a supportive environment for innovation and investment.
 
• Policies can address challenges like infrastructure, funding, and regulatory issues.
 
• Effective policies can lead to sustainable growth and global competitiveness.
